title: Build Connectivity-aware News Policy
prompt: Expose validated and metered hints, keep local reading available, coalesce restoration sync, defer large media, and test handover and false-positive connectivity.
successCriteria: No capability is treated as guaranteed API reachability.
Callbacks are registered and removed with one owner.
Repeated restoration creates only one sync request.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class ConnectivityPolicy(private val manager: ConnectivityManager, private val sync: SyncScheduler)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
